name: quoxseo
tagline: SEO intelligence with a witnessed history no other tool can offer.
description: First-party SEO and AI-visibility intelligence on the Quox evidence substrate. A daily org-scoped crawl of your site joins Google Search Console data, internal link graph and orphan detection into one URL warehouse; every crawl is hash-anchored and WARD-witnessed on an append-only chain, and consecutive crawls diff into signed change events, so 'that deploy noindexed 183 URLs' is a tamper-evident dated fact, not a dashboard impression.
shortDescription: Witnessed SEO warehouse: crawl + GSC + change evidence
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: One warehouse record per URL: crawl health, search performance, inlinks, orphan status
WARD-witnessed history: every crawl signed onto an append-only hash chain
Signed change events: noindex transitions, canonical and schema changes, added and removed pages
Independent verification: recompute the chain, signatures and root hashes yourself
Free-data first: GSC and your own crawl; paid data only ever behind budget gates

warehouse.name: URL Warehouse
warehouse.description: Every URL as one entity: status, metadata, structured data, word count, internal links, orphan flag, and Search Console impressions, clicks and position.

witnessedHistory.name: Witnessed History
witnessedHistory.description: Each crawl appends to a WARD chain signed with a pinned key. Deleted or skipped runs are visible as sequence gaps to anyone.

changeEvents.name: Signed Change Events
changeEvents.description: Consecutive crawls diff into discrete events: noindexed, title changed, canonical moved, page added or removed. Deploy regressions become dated facts.

verification.name: Independent Verify
verification.description: One click re-verifies chain integrity, tip signatures and per-crawl root hashes against the warehouse rows.
